history.order: distinct prefix aid by last occurrence (seq) desc, then aid asc

popular.order: distinct sessions of Q_k with the type in the prefix desc, then aid asc

features.name: s_len
features.formula: events in the prefix

features.formula: distinct aid in the prefix

features.name: s_carts
features.formula: carts events in the prefix

features.name: s_orders
features.formula: orders events in the prefix

features.name: s_dur
features.formula: ts of the last minus ts of the first prefix event, s

features.name: p_clicks
features.formula: clicks events of the aid in the prefix

features.name: p_carts
features.formula: carts events of the aid in the prefix

features.name: p_orders

features.name: p_last_pos
features.formula: position of the last occurrence of the aid from the prefix end (1 = last event)

features.formula: ts of the last prefix event minus ts of the last occurrence of the aid, s

features.name: p_is_last
